title: Concept: Module locked at an incompatible major
description: go.sum declares a `+incompatible` version in go.sum, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `+incompatible` version in go.sum.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.sum (go).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `+incompatible` version in go.sum.
